text: Grigol Gegelia - Summoning Pavel Herchinsky to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is another clear proof that this government serves anti-Georgian goals and aspirations (27.04.2026, 12:12)

The summoning of Herchinsky is another clear proof that this government always serves anti-Georgian goals and aspirations, Grigol Gegelia, Foreign Secretary of the "Lelo - Strong Georgia" party, said regarding the summoning of European Union Ambassador Pavel Herchinsky.

According to Gegelia, at a time when the ambassadors of Iran and Hungary have not been summoned by the Foreign Ministry, the summoning of representatives of Georgia's strategic partners shows that the Georgian Dream government is working to harm the country's strategic interests.

"At a time when the Iranian ambassador has not been summoned and has not been questioned about why he threatened the Georgian people with such language, at a time when the Hungarian ambassador has not been summoned and has not been asked about the Russian spy who worked in Georgia for 4 years, what we were dealing with, whether Hungary was informed and how we should perceive it, that under Hungarian diplomatic cover he was working in this city, most likely, a Russian spy, and in such a situation, Bochorishvili gives himself the right to attack all the ambassadors who are representatives of this country's strategic partner state. Whether it is because of the statement made at Ilia State University or because of elementary pro-democracy statements, he summons the ambassadors of those states that are the most important strategic partners of our country to resolve the case. This clearly proves that the so-called government is a hostile government of Georgia, which does everything to undermine the national interests of our country." "To harm domestic or foreign political interests," Grigol Gegelia said.

As a reminder, the EU Ambassador to Georgia, Pavel Herczynski, at the European External Action Service in Brussels, where the documentary photo exhibition “Georgia in Focus” was opened, noted that Georgia is no longer on the right trajectory. According to the ambassador, “the authorities have chosen an alternative, authoritarian model and are taking Georgia away from the European Union”. “Georgia is at a crossroads. Georgia’s future has not yet been written, but what will be decided in the coming weeks and months will determine whether Georgia belongs to the family of European countries, based on democracy, the rule of law and human rights, or, unfortunately, will return to its dark past. My main message to the Georgian people is “do not lose hope”. We must not allow Georgia and the wonderful, warm, hospitable Georgian people to return to the dark times of violence, civil war, poverty, hardship, corruption. "This is not the future they deserve. As soon as the government expresses a desire to cooperate with us, we will do everything to help Georgia become a member of the European Union," said Herczynski, quoted by Netgazeti.
Following the aforementioned statement, the ambassador was summoned to the Foreign Ministry.
